notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Thanks for everyone's feedback on AirRaid! It's been an exciting journey so far.

I got a good amount of feedback about the scoring system not being very useful since it was usually 0 after shooting too much. So! The points awarded per unit has been increased. Chase those high scores!

Keep shootin'

- Pilea

tags.balance_change: The points awarded per unit has been increased.
